display.text:
name: CI

# Source details were not provided in the fixture. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>
# with values confirmed from the application's manifest/lockfile before use.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:

# Least privilege by default: no job receives any token scope unless it
# explicitly opts in below.
permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
      - uses: actions/setup-<TOOLCHAIN>@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
        with:
          <VERSION_KEY>: <VERSION>
          cache: <LOCKFILE_KEY>
      - name: Install from lockfile
        run: <INSTALL_CMD_LOCKFILE_FROZEN>
      - name: Build
        run: <BUILD_CMD>
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
      - uses: actions/setup-<TOOLCHAIN>@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
        with:
          <VERSION_KEY>: <VERSION>
          cache: <LOCKFILE_KEY>
      - name: Install from lockfile
        run: <INSTALL_CMD_LOCKFILE_FROZEN>
      - name: Lint and typecheck
        run: <LINT_CMD>
      - name: Test
        run: <TEST_CMD>

  release:
    name: Release
    needs: [build, test]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: production
      url: <RELEASE_URL>
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
      - name: Download verified build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@<PINNED_ACTION_SHA>
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - name: Verify artifact integrity before publish
        run: <CHECKSUM_VERIFY_CMD>
      - name: Publish with short-lived OIDC credentials
        run: <PUBLISH_CMD>
